stem: In aqueous ethanol, which bromide undergoes solvolysis fastest by an $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ pathway?

verdicts.working: SN1 rate depends mainly on carbocation stability. 2-Bromo-2-methylpropane forms a tertiary carbocation, the most stable among the choices.

working:
Rate of $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ depends on carbocation stability.
$3^\circ > 2^\circ > 1^\circ$
2-Bromo-2-methylpropane forms a $3^\circ$ carbocation; it reacts fastest.

Independent check: SN1 rate depends mainly on carbocation stability. 2-Bromo-2-methylpropane forms a tertiary carbocation, the most stable among the choices.
solution: The rate of an $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ reaction depends on carbocation stability: $3^\circ > 2^\circ > 1^\circ$. 2-Bromo-2-methylpropane forms the most stable, tertiary carbocation and hence undergoes solvolysis fastest.
